scope: Native pthread execution of finite AOT guest procedures. Original startup integration remains subject to its diagnostic result; component success is not game acceptance.

create.guest_stack: PE default reserve or documented request rounding, fully committed with a separate inaccessible 64 KiB lower reservation
create.limitations: No demand growth, exact Windows guard-page geometry, stack-overflow SEH, active suspension, external termination, remote processes or last-thread process exit
create.start: CREATE_SUSPENDED gates all guest execution, including thread attach. Process initialization readiness is also required. A child may finish before CreateThread returns.

lifecycle.thread_environment: Independent CPU, VM stack, TEB, static TLS template/zero fill, Win32 ID and LastError. Host module metadata is copied before attach; no guest header trust.
lifecycle.notifications: Serialized TLS callbacks followed by DllMain in configured module order on attach; reverse module order on detach. No EXE entry invocation as DllMain.
lifecycle.exit: Normal stdcall return, ExitThread and balanced FreeLibraryAndExitThread. FLS drains while TEB exists, before module detach and once again afterward. Guest stack and environment are freed before signaling the thread object.
lifecycle.handles: Running owner, each duplicate and pending wait retain separate references. CloseHandle does not terminate a thread. Exit code persists until final handle close. A signaled thread remains signaled.

diagnostics: Track current callback CPU per native thread. Do not save a supposedly coherent whole-memory snapshot while guest workers are active.
